name: Database normalization
short_description: The practice of structuring a relational data model to remove redundancy and improve data integrity, for example keeping one customer record instead of several copies.

evidence.quote: First is normalization. This is about removing redundancy without killing your performance.
In der Praxis kann eine Übernormalisierung die Dataverse-Leistung beeinträchtigen,
Normalize the fact, flatten the dimension.
Then we have the illusion of normalization.
